competitor_cards.top_signal_headline: Coveo published positioning claiming 'Enterprise Search Has Always Forced a Trade-Off. Conversational Search Ends It.' and 'For decades, enterprise search required users to meet the system halfway. AI just changed that contract - for good.'

competitor_cards.why_it_matters: This is competitive framing that positions legacy search vendors (including Algolia for enterprise use cases) as forcing 'trade-offs' that conversational AI eliminates. It is a direct attack on keyword-first search paradigms.

theses.thesis: Coveo is racing to own the "agentic commerce" category narrative before the market consolidates, signaling they view autonomous multi-step LLM workflows as the next defensible moat beyond traditional search relevance.
